main.description: Writes a dev.knotless.theme record in the account logged in to this appview's web pages, for anyone to choose. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets: the appview writes with the session it keeps for that account. Clients holding their own session write the record themselves.

errors.description: A name empty or too long, or a colour not as #rrggbb.
errors.name: InvalidRequest

errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.
errors.name: AuthenticationRequired

description: Publishes a theme as the account logged in to this appview's pages.
